premise: Frog and Snail wish for rain and Butterfly wishes for sun; the rain comes and Butterfly has to hide, so Frog and Snail wish for sun for her — and the sky gives them both, and a rainbow for everyone.
inspiration: The Father and His Two Daughters (Aesop), where one wants rain and the other sun; turned: the friends start wishing for each other, and nobody has to lose.
lesson: A wish for a friend is the best wish.

en-US.title: Frog and the Two Wishes
en-US.text: [curious] What's the best weather? {frog:enter} Frog knew. {frog:hop x2} "Rain! Splishy, splashy rain!" Slowly, {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Snail crawled up and nodded. "Too dry out here," he said, {snail:live hide} and hid in his shell. {snail:face happy} "Rain is lovely!" But {butterfly:enter} Butterfly, fluttering by, wasn't so sure. {butterfly:live shake-head} "Sun! Warm, golden sun!" So Frog wished for rain. Snail wished for rain. And Butterfly wished for sun. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter… down came the rain! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Frog bounced for joy. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Snail stretched out his eye stalks. But Butterfly's wings were getting wet. She flew to the red {mushroom:enter} mushroom, {butterfly:go under mushroom} tucked in under the cap, {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} and folded her wings. [sad] "Oh dear." Frog looked at Butterfly. {snail:face sad} Snail looked at Butterfly. Then they made a new wish. [whispers] "Sun, please. For our friend." {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} And the rain stopped, and out came the sun. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} and up she fluttered. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Look! The rain and the sun had made a rainbow. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Everybody's wish, all at once.

es-ES.title: Rana y los dos deseos
es-ES.text: [curious] ¿Qué tiempo es el mejor? {frog:enter} Rana lo tenía clarísimo. {frog:hop x2} —¡La lluvia, que salpica! Despacito, llegó {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Caracol, y asintió. —Qué seco está todo —dijo, {snail:live hide} y se metió en su concha. {snail:face happy} —¡La lluvia es lo mejor! Pero {butterfly:enter} Mariposa, que pasaba revoloteando, no lo veía así. {butterfly:live shake-head} —¡Qué va! ¡El sol calentito! Así que Rana pidió lluvia. Caracol pidió lluvia. Y Mariposa pidió sol. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc… ¡y se puso a llover! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Rana saltó de alegría. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Caracol estiró los cuernos. Pero a Mariposa se le mojaban las alas. Voló hasta la {mushroom:enter} seta roja, {butterfly:go under mushroom} se metió debajo {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} y plegó las alas. [sad] —Vaya… Rana miró a Mariposa. {snail:face sad} Caracol miró a Mariposa. Y pidieron otro deseo. [whispers] —Sol, por favor. Para nuestra amiga. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Y dejó de llover, y salió el sol. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} y echó a volar. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] ¡Mirad! La lluvia y el sol habían pintado un arcoíris. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] El deseo de todos, a la vez.

ja-JP.title: カエルさんと ふたつの おねがい
ja-JP.text: [curious]いちばんすてきなおてんきは？{frog:enter}カエルさんは、しっています。{frog:hop x2}「あめ！ぴちぴち、ちゃぷちゃぷ！」 ゆっくり{snail:enter}{snail:go to frog}カタツムリくんもきて、うんうん。「ここは、かわきすぎ」 と{snail:live hide}からにもぐって、{snail:face happy}「あめが、いちばん！」 でも{butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんは、ちがいました。{butterfly:live shake-head}「おひさまよ！ぽかぽかの！」 ふたりは、あめをおねがい。チョウチョさんは、おひさまを。{canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}ぽつぽつ…ざあざあ、あめです！{frog:face happy}{frog:live jump}カエルさんは、大よろこび。{snail:live stretch-eyes}カタツムリくんは、つのをにょきっ。でもチョウチョさんは、はねがぬれて、赤い{mushroom:enter}キノコの{butterfly:go under mushroom}かさの下へ。{butterfly:face sad}{butterfly:live rest hold}はねをとじて、[sad]「こまったわ。」 カエルさんは、チョウチョさんを見ました。{snail:face sad}カタツムリくんも。そして、あたらしいおねがい。[whispers]「おひさま、おねがい。ともだちのために。」 {canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}あめがやんで、おひさまが！{butterfly:live rest resume}チョウチョさんがはねをひらいて…{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go to sky}ひらひら、そらへ。{canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s}[gasps]見て！あめとおひさまが、にじをつくったよ。{all:face happy}{all:hearts}[happily]みんなのおねがい、いっぺんにかなったね。
